name: Adv. N. L. Rajah, Senior Advocate
bio: Designated Senior Advocate at the Madras High Court. Expert in constitutional writs, civil disputes, consumer protection, energy laws, and arbitration.

name: Adv. Sriram Panchu, Senior Advocate
bio: Pioneer of court-annexed mediation in India and Senior Advocate at the Madras High Court. Resolves complex domestic, partition, and family assets negotiations.
